comparison.objective: Manually close an air circuit breaker when its motor operator is unavailable versus commission a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Title indicates manual breaker closing; body and specs provide no actuation sequence, force, interlock, or manipulation rubric. Candidate requires hex-key/collar manipulation and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: No success rubric is supplied for pr-978; candidate requires quantified energy, velocity, stroke, repeatability, damage exclusions, and a retention test.
comparison.reason: Rubric details are missing, but the explicit breaker-closing objective is clearly different from tuning and locking a shock absorber; missing thresholds alone do not create a plausible duplicate.
